        COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM transactions t
    JOIN yearmonth y ON t.TransactionID = y.Id

    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment

    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        AVG(total_consumption) AS avg_annual

    CustomerID,
    Segment,
    ROUND(AVG(total_consumption), 2) AS avg_annual

SELECT 
    ROUND( 
        (SUM(SUBTRACT(YEAR(NOW()), YEAR(birthday))) / COUNT(ID)) 
    AS Average_Age 
FROM (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS Patient_ID,
        p.sex AS Patient_Sex,
        l.tcho AS Lab_T_Cho,
        p.birthday AS Birthday_Date,
        l.date AS Lab_Date
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
    WHERE p.sex = 'M'
      AND l.tcho >= 250
)
GROUP BY 
    p.id

WITH 
-- Join comments and votes to filter by postId and userId
joined_comments AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id AS comment_id,
        c.score,
        c.post_id,
        c.user_id,
        v.up_vote_count AS up_votes
    FROM comments c
    LEFT JOIN votes v ON c.post_id = v.post_id AND c.user_id = v.user_id
    WHERE c.score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
),
-- Count users with 0 up votes
count_zero_upvotes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS user_count_0_upvotes
    FROM joined_comments c
    WHERE c.up_votes = 0
),
-- Total users with scores in range
total_users_in_range AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_score_in_range
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
),
-- Calculate percentage
percentage AS (
    SELECT CAST(ROUND((COUNT(*) - COUNT(*) * 100) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS REAL) AS percentage
    FROM count_zero_upvotes
)
SELECT CAST(ROUND(percentage * 100) AS INTEGER) AS percentage_result

```sql
WITH 
-- Join comments and votes to filter by postId and userId
joined_comments AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id AS comment_id,
        c.score,
        c.post_id,
        c.user_id,
        v.up_vote_count AS up_votes
    FROM comments c
    LEFT JOIN votes v ON c.post_id = v.post_id AND c.user_id = v.user_id
    WHERE c.score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
),
-- Count users with 0 up votes
count_zero_upvotes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS user_count_0_upvotes
    FROM joined_comments c
    WHERE c.up_votes = 0
),
-- Total users with scores in range
total_users_in_range AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_score_in_range
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
),
-- Calculate percentage
percentage AS (
    SELECT CAST(ROUND((COUNT(*) - COUNT(*) * 100) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS REAL) AS percentage
    FROM count_zero_upvotes
)
SELECT CAST(ROUND(percentage * 100) AS INTEGER) AS percentage_result;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN power IS NULL OR power = '*' THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS has_power
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
WHERE language = 'French'
GROUP BY foreign_data_id
HAVING language = 'French'
AND (
    SUM(has_power) > 0
)
```
